parole.significato: someone who does uncredited work for another person (e.g. a ghostwriter)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Czech muřín, a learned borrowing from Latin Maurus, borrowed from Ancient Greek Μαῦρος (Maûros, “Moor”). Doublet of Maur, morus, and Murzyn.
Borrowed from Czech oltář, from Latin altāre, from Proto-Italic *altos + Latin -ālis. Doublet of altaria.

parole.significato: leather bag for food carried by soldiers and hunters
parole.testo: Borrowed from Czech tanystra (now obsolete), ultimately from Latin canistrum. Doublet of tornister.
